text: Water rising fast on the harbour road. Two buildings cut off near the fish market. People moved to the school on the hill. No injuries reported yet.
Confirming flooding on harbour road. Water about knee height. The school on the hill is being used as a shelter, roughly 90 people there now, mostly families.
Bridge at Kato Vrisi looks damaged, cracks on the approach. Nobody should drive over it.
The clinic at Ano Petra has no power since 05:00. They have a generator but fuel for maybe six hours. Contact the duty nurse Maria Antonopoulou on +30 694 555 0177.
Power still out at Ano Petra clinic. Fuel delivery requested through the municipality. Around forty patients on site including dialysis.
Harbour road impassable. Shelter at the hill school needs blankets and drinking water. Someone said the water supply is contaminated but that is not confirmed.
Engineering team inspected the Kato Vrisi bridge. Structural cracks confirmed on the eastern approach. Road closed to all vehicles. Diversion via the ridge road adds twenty minutes.
Heard the whole district will be evacuated tonight. Nobody official has said this. People are panicking, please someone confirm.
Shelter coordinator at the hill school reports 120 people now, needs baby formula and dry clothing. Two elderly residents need medication resupply.
Confirmed 118 people at the hill school shelter. Water and blankets delivered at 09:00. Outstanding needs are baby formula, dry clothing and a medication resupply for two residents.
